name: kmm-migration-workflow
description: Speckit-style orchestrator for Android → Kotlin Multiplatform migrations and on-device QA. Architecture-before-code, clean-code-first (refactor when source isn't clean, surgical when it is, behaviour preserved either way), checkpoint PRs for big migrations, baseline-first TDD, document-first artifacts. Opus orchestrates; sonnet/haiku subagents do labour. Live-source discipline; opt-in retrospectives. Read-only PR audit mode for any KMM PR. /kmm-qa runs the same no-silent-patches fix discipline against a live device — build → install → logcat → diagnose → failing test → fix.
